ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels forming the perimeter and central hub, versus 35% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated in large interior lobe patches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous regions are visible. The left lobe contains a large semi-triangular white field with peripheral dark mottling. The right lobe contains a fragmented white field heavily interrupted by dark linear and circular pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a calculated internal vertex angle of approximately 85 degrees and significant depth extending into the peduncle connection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration across the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by irregular jagged peaks and deep valleys isolated from the background water pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory curving upward and outward from the notch toward the distal tips, with a sharp increase in curvature at the lateral boundaries.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of numerous circular high-contrast white rings (barnacle scars) distributed across the dark central stalk and within the interior white patches of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, roughly parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the lower-right white patch of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged trauma and irregular loss of tissue along the trailing edge contour; prominent parallel rake mark scarring on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'salt-and-pepper' dark speckling pattern within the high-intensity white field of the left lobe.
